entities.name: Galip Paşa Mosque
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Galib Pasha Mosque is a mosque situated on the Bağdat Street in Kadıköy, Istanbul. It was constructed in 1899 by Abdullah Galib Pasha in the Abdulhamid II period, as written on its entrance. In front of the Galib Pasha Mosque is the Galib Pasha Mosque Fountain.
